senses.gloss:
Cirañjīva
surname of Jagannātha (a. of Yogasaṅgraha, Weber 958), son of Lakṣmaṇa of Rāḍhīvam3śa.

Cirañjīva
poet. Padyāvalī p. 202, verse 157; Subhāṣitāvalī compiled by Sumati, IO. 4033.

Cirañjīvabhaṭṭa
--C. on Jyotiṣkedāra of Kṛpāśaṅkara. BORI. 913 of 1886-92. Peters. IV. p. 34 (no. 913).

Cirañjīva_Bhaṭṭa_Rāmadeva
also known a. Daivajña Ratnākara; of Gauḍa (Rāḍhapura), belonging to Kaśyapagotra, son of Śatāvadhāna Rāghavendra, grandson of Kāśīnātha Sāmudrikācārya (NCC. IV. p. 134a) an. pupil of Raghudeva Nyāyālaṅkāra; patronized by Yaśovanta Sim3ha, Naib Nazim of Dacca 1st half of 18th Cent.
--Kāvyavilāsa. alam3k. See NCC. IV. p. 106.
--Tājikaratnākara. Alwar 1805. Extr. 503. RASB. X. 7098. [Page065-a.
--Mādhavacampū. L. 115.
Ed. Satyavrata Samasrami, Hindu Commentator IV. 4. 7. Calcutta, 1871.
--Vidvanmodataraṅgiṇī. a survey of philosophical an. religious systems. GD. 625. IO. 2446. TD. 8132.
Pt.. (1) 2nd edn. Calcutta, 1834. (2) Veṅk. Press. Bombay, 1912.
--Vṛttaratnāvalī. metrics. Illustrative verses here are on Yaśvanta Sinha of Dacca; C. 1731 A. D. Hpr. III. 280. IO. 5188.
--Śivastotra. mentioned in his Kāvyavilāsa.
--Śṛṅgārataṭinī. Oudh 1877. 22.
See S. K. D., Skt. Poe. 2nd edn. p.. 279-80; Adyar Library Bulletin, VI. i. Mss. Notes, p.. 53-5; an. Sāhityacandrikā 1903, 1904.

Cirañjīva_Miśra
son of Pūrṇānanda Miśra.
--Śaraccandrodaya. Mithilā III. 362 (acc. to col. Māthura, son of Cirañjīvamiśra, is the a.).

Cirañjīvaśarman_Maithila
--Atisūkṣmam Gayākṛtyam (compiled).
--Gayākṛtya (compiled).
Pt.. Darbhanga, 1914. with Atisūkṣmamº. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 217. 661. 896.

Cirañjīvirāmāyaṇa
a short poem on the Rāmāyaṇa story. MT. 3988 (d).

Cirantanaśaraṇa
poet. Skm. p. 226. See also Śaraṇa.

Cirasaṃcia
BORI. 1269 (1) of 1887-91 (in a collection). BORI. D. XVII. iii. 735 (fol. 2a).

Cīravāsābhairavamāhātmya
Pt.. in Tīrthayātrānirūpaṇa compiled by Balirāma Śarman. work no. 28. with Hindi transl. 1st & 2nd edn. 1920. See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 661.
